evidence.locator: SPDX official text, Sections 1-4 and metadata: Creative Commons Attribution 1.0 Generic (CC-BY-1.0), deprecated=false, osi=false, fsf=false; the broad copyright/content-work grant is paired with attribution, public-display/performance, no-sublicensing, and technological-measure conditions, so it is nonstandard for this software-oriented guide

SPDX official text, Section 3 and Section 4(a)-(b): the grant permits creation of Derivative Works and does not require source disclosure or licensing a larger work under the same license; the Collective Work apart from the Work is expressly not subject to this license

SPDX official text, Section 3(a)-(d): worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive, perpetual rights to reproduce, create and reproduce Derivative Works, distribute, publicly display, publicly perform, and digitally perform the Work and Derivative Works, in all media and formats; no commercial or private-use limitation is stated, while sublicensing is expressly excluded by Section 4(a)

SPDX official text, Section 4(a)-(b): every distributed, publicly displayed, publicly performed, or digitally performed Work/Derivative Work must carry the license copy or URI, retain copyright/license/disclaimer notices, and provide Original Author/title/use credit; attribution and the public-display/performance surfaces are not represented losslessly by the obligation vocabulary, retained as unknown

SPDX official text, Section 4(a)-(b): notice and attribution duties attach to distribution, public display, public performance, and public digital performance of the Work, Derivative Works, or Collective Works; distribution is represented directly, while the distinct display/performance triggers have no vocabulary value and are retained as unknown

SPDX official text, Section 4(a): distribution/display/performance must remain under this license, no altered or restrictive terms may be imposed, sublicensing is prohibited, notices must remain intact, and inconsistent technological access measures are prohibited; Sections 5(b)-6 disclaim warranties and limit liability, and the closing paragraph restricts Creative Commons trademark use; the non-sublicensing/technology and attribution details are not losslessly represented and are retained as unknown
SPDX official text, complete Sections 1-8: the grant covers copyright rights and contains no express patent grant, patent covenant, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause

SPDX official text, Section 4(a)-(b): license copy/URI, intact license/disclaimer/copyright notices, and author/title/derivative-use credit are required across distribution, public display, public performance, and public digital performance, creating a material multi-surface attribution and notice burden

SPDX official metadata and text: CC-BY-1.0 is non-deprecated but is a Creative Commons content-work license (osi=false, fsf=false) with attribution, public display/performance triggers, no sublicensing, technological-measure, and trademark conditions; those legal/content dimensions are not all represented exactly by vocabulary 1.0.0, so the profile is reviewed but not recommendable
